topic: 注意与意识的双重解离
core_question: 注意与意识可以被双重解离吗？
的实验证据是什么，它们分别指向什么神经机制？

sources.citation: Koch C, Tsuchiya N (2007) Attention and consciousness: two distinct brain processes. Trends Cogn Sci 11(1):16-22.
sources.note: 仅读摘要；综述论文，论证注意（分析器）与意识（综合器）的概念和实验分离
used_for: 注意分析器/意识综合器比喻

sources.citation: Wyart V, Tallon-Baudry C (2008) Neural dissociation between visual awareness and spatial attention. J Neurosci 28(10):2667-79.
sources.note: MEG 研究发现 γ 频率双解离：54-64Hz=意识，76-90Hz=注意

sources.citation: Simons DJ, Chabris CF (1999) Gorillas in our midst: sustained inattentional blindness for dynamic events. Perception 28(9):1059-74.
sources.note: 仅读摘要；'隐形大猩猩'实验，不注意盲视的经典证明
used_for: 有注意无意识范例背景

sources.citation: Block N (2011) Perceptual consciousness overflows cognitive access. Trends Cogn Sci 15(12):567-75.
sources.note: 仅读摘要；溢出假说论证，P-consciousness > A-consciousness

sources.citation: Cohen MA, Cavanagh P, Chun MM, Nakayama K (2012) The attentional requirements of consciousness. Trends Cogn Sci 16(8):411-7.
sources.note: 仅读摘要；反驳'无注意有意识'：注意是意识必要（非充分）条件

sources.citation: Pitts MA, Metzler S, Hillyard SA (2014) Isolating neural correlates of conscious perception from neural correlates of reporting one's perception. Front Psychol 5:1078.
sources.note: PMC 全文开放；VAN vs P3b 的无报告范式分离；VAN 是比 P3b 更好的 NCC 候选

sources.citation: Usher M, Bronfman ZZ, Talmor S, Jacobson H, Eitam B (2018) Consciousness without report: insights from summary statistics and inattention 'blindness'. Philos Trans R Soc B 373(1755):20170354.
sources.journal: Philosophical Transactions of the Royal Society B
sources.note: PMC 全文开放；摘要统计范式，弱溢出证据（67%颜色多样性辨别）

sources.citation: Maier A, Tsuchiya N (2021) Growing evidence for separate neural mechanisms for attention and consciousness. Atten Percept Psychophys 83(2):558-79.
sources.note: 仅读摘要；综述2021年前的多尺度神经解离证据

sources.citation: Aru J, Bachmann T (2013) Phenomenal awareness can emerge without attention. Front Hum Neurosci 7:891.
sources.note: PMC 全文开放；TMS磷光、梦、余像等现象支持无注意可有意识
